name: ghc_campaign_event_lock
status: source added; CI compile, round-trip and bytecode hash pin pending
behavior: Provides 16 mission-local event IDs, one active event per local player, one owner per shared event ID, owner-only release, optional shared completion, cancellation/abort without completion, and session-pair validation. Different event IDs can be owned concurrently by different players. No client creation, input polling or game-memory writes.
